results.context: Our whole team is ambitious and strives for top performance.
results.label: Inclusive: Communal
results.reason: Emphasizes cooperative, compassionate or supportive characteristics and thus inclusive attributes.
results.solution: Use more of such wording to express cooperation, care or purpose.
